get.summary: Find what was said or noted, and meetings by title or by who was in them
get.description: Full-text search over the workspace's meeting notes, transcripts (live and final), meeting titles and attendees, best match first: titles, then notes, then transcript lines, then attendees. Words match whole, in any language, case-insensitive; accents count ("reunião" ≠ "reuniao"). A transcript (or a recording's notes) matches when it has every word; within it, each line (or part of the notes) with any of them is a hit, those with all of them first. Hits are lines and parts, not meetings: several can come from one meeting.
